summary: Typographic cover identifies a four-week operational review and the decision to observe longer. No product photograph is forced onto the quantitative brief.
95% is the dominant observation with an 88% baseline. Cutoff definition, cancellations and different-order-mix causal limitation are readable in separate native text fields.
Native line chart preserves chronological 88/91/94/95 values with a 0–100 scale. Its commentary avoids causal claims and retains missing weekly denominators and rounding.
Native table has narrow aligned numeric columns and a wide definition column. Percentages/minutes remain correct; missing exception counts and pick-time distributions are explicit.
Orange marks one unresolved evidence gap: 40 missing timestamps excluded from the rate. Smaller weekend and single-site limitations remain visible, without equal-size cards.
The action page retains two additional observation weeks, timestamp investigation and weekend sampling. Rollout remains undecided; no owners or dates were invented.

Reviewed the full fictional source and six-page export. The quantitative reading brief has its own paper/ink/status identity, native chart/table and explicit limitations. No causal inference, rollout approval, owners or dates were invented. Zero audit findings does not prove human authorship perception.
